title: Choose a route, then decide whether to review it
question: How does the winning intent differ from the decision to defer?
summary: A deferred request is unresolved by the automatic router, not automatically a proven routing failure.

steps.title: Keep the probability columns
steps.body: Each probability column belongs to one class in the fitted model’s order.

steps.title: Apply the routing threshold
steps.body: Low top probability sends a request to a person. The threshold changes coverage; it does not retrain the classifier.
steps.excerpt_label: Abbreviated code; full function in notebook.

steps.title: Inspect the top-two margin
steps.body: The difference between the two largest probabilities describes ambiguity between alternatives. It is not the same as top probability.
